title: Houston doctor --json output
description: The object `houston doctor --json` prints (schemaVersion 1): the same graded checks the interactive /doctor shows. The exit code is 1 when `ok` is false (a check failed), else 0. Groups and checks may be added in later releases, and objects may carry fields not listed here; a consumer should ignore what it does not know. API keys never appear: a provider's row says only whether a key is set.

schemaVersion.description: Raised only for a breaking change to this shape.

ok.description: False when any check has status fail.

groups.description: Report sections in display order, such as Houston, Model, Sandbox, Tools, Language servers, MCP and Terminal. A section with no checks is left out.

label.description: What was checked: a provider id, a tool name, an MCP server id, version, node, install, and so on.

status.description: ok is healthy, warn works but is worth knowing, fail is broken.

fix.description: What to do about it. Present only on warn or fail rows that have a known fix.
